summary: Your CBD practice offers a full range of treatments, but the page has template leftovers, no proof and no way to book online from the page itself.

findings.problem: The heading says Dental clinic near the Eastern Suburbs, but the address is 185 Elizabeth Street in the CBD.
findings.cost: Patients from the east may expect a closer clinic and go elsewhere.

findings.problem: No booking form, only a link to /book. No WhatsApp, reviews, or named dentists, and Meet The Team names none.
findings.cost: Patients choose a dentist by face and reviews, and many book from their phone.
findings.fix: Booking form, WhatsApp, reviews and dentist profiles.

findings.problem: A placeholder reads This is an example. To display your Instagram posts, double-click here, and Delivery & Returns Policy appears as plain text.
findings.cost: Placeholder text on a dental site looks unfinished.
findings.fix: Remove placeholders and use a real feed or none.

findings.problem: Typos such as patient care should always comes first and Crows Feet, a repeated menu, and a footer link split into Eas and tern Suburbs.
findings.cost: Errors lower trust in clinical care.

redesign: Online booking and WhatsApp on every page.
Reviews, named dentists and a before and after gallery to prove quality.
